business_problem: Lumen needed to scale highly tailored B2B marketing across long, complex buying journeys where thousands of assets must be produced weekly for different industries, personas, and channels without losing brand consistency or slowing campaign launches.
solution_summary: Lumen uses Adobe GenStudio as the operating layer for an AI-driven B2B content supply chain rather than as a single point tool. Creative and marketing teams jointly define persona-based messaging, brand rules, and design assets, then use GenStudio for Performance Marketing to generate channel-specific paid social, display, banner, and email variants for different industries and personas. Adobe Firefly produces campaign imagery, while Custom Models let Lumen train Firefly on its own IP so generated assets stay aligned to brand guidelines. Adobe Workfront acts as the work-management and approval hub, automatically ingesting campaign assets for legal and brand review, and Adobe Express expands controlled content customization to more marketers. GenStudio also returns attribute-level performance insights so teams can test, adapt, and optimize content in near real time across channels.

solution_components.name: Adobe GenStudio
solution_components.role: Provides the end-to-end content supply chain environment where Lumen teams collaborate, generate assets, test creative, adapt campaigns, and review performance.

solution_components.name: GenStudio for Performance Marketing
solution_components.role: Generates on-brand campaign content variations for paid social ads, display ads, banners, and marketing emails using persona-based messaging and approved design assets.

solution_components.name: Adobe Firefly
solution_components.role: Generates campaign imagery for different audience segments as part of campaign content creation.

solution_components.name: Custom Models
solution_components.role: Trains Firefly on Lumen's own IP so marketers can scale generated content while staying within brand guidelines defined by creatives.

solution_components.name: Adobe Workfront
solution_components.role: Acts as Lumen's work management hub and automatically ingests campaign assets into legal and brand approval workflows.

solution_components.name: Adobe Express
solution_components.role: Lets more marketing and creative users create and customize approved content variations while reinforcing brand integrity.

data_flow: Creative and marketing teams develop persona messaging and brand assets, which Adobe Workfront ingests for legal and brand approvals. Approved inputs flow into GenStudio for Performance Marketing, where AI-generated copy and Adobe Firefly imagery, enhanced by Custom Models trained on Lumen IP, are turned into channel-specific variants. Content is then activated across LinkedIn, Meta, display, and email, with GenStudio performance insights feeding back into campaign optimization.
business_outcome: Lumen shortened campaign launch cycles, increased its ability to create personalized content across industries and personas, improved team agility, and used real-time performance signals to refine campaigns and boost engagement.
